common_holdout.design: 3x3 contiguous spatial blocks; 12-pixel (1.2 km) training buffer; six truth-bearing blocks; emission and scoring restricted to held-out block
common_holdout.target_comparator: freshly reconstructed H-D/H-H 50/50 baseline, both ungated for frozen receipt reproduction and both q10-gated for paired candidate comparison
common_holdout.promotion_rule: Fresh ungated baseline reproduces 0.285340602656319 within 1e-5; final candidate after fold-specific q10 Stage-1 gating exceeds the frozen ungated best and same-fold q10-gated H-D/H-H mean, paired gated mean DTI delta > 0, >=4/6 paired folds improve, approved area >=2/3 with Stage-1 lift <=1.5, and every candidate point lies inside approved tiles; no post-hoc parameter tuning.
common_holdout.slot_policy: No portal submission or weekly slot is authorized by local holdout evidence. Local TIFF may be written only after proxy promotion, format, scoped uniqueness, all-points-inside-approved validation, and Stage-1 non-dominance gates pass.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Cross-scale potential-field tilt-edge persistence
ranked_hypotheses.operator: At sigma 2 and 5 px, normalized-Gaussian smooth raw same-field vertical-gradient and absolute supplied horizontal-gradient bands. theta=atan2(VG,abs(HG)); E=rank(abs(HG))*exp(-abs(theta)/0.20 radians). Use min(E_sigma2,E_sigma5) per field; joint feature=sqrt(magnetic_persistence*gravity_persistence). Local gravity HG is signed and metadata does not establish whether it is full 2-D magnitude or one signed component, so this is a tilt-like partial-gradient proxy, not the conventional total-horizontal-derivative tilt angle.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Amplitude-normalized near-zero tilt-angle/phase edges that persist across two scales and have independent magnetic and gravity support.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_fault: Buried faulted contacts can juxtapose magnetic susceptibility and density contrasts under basin fill while showing weak surface relief; this is a structural proxy, not proof of a fault.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H-E uses local gravity/basement/conductivity gradients, H-G compares TMI/gravity gradient orientation, H-H pairs finite edge endpoints with a conductive bridge, H-D/H-M use surface-relief coherence/scale coincidence. No implemented arm uses a signed vertical-to-horizontal derivative phase ratio with scale persistence and joint magnetic/gravity support.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_benefit: Moderate but uncertain; no numeric uplift forecast.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium; only existing hash-pinned competition derivative bands.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Directional conductivity contrast across an independent basement edge
ranked_hypotheses.operator: Measure robust along-edge versus cross-edge conductivity contrast at 150-800 m offsets around independently detected structural axes; remove broad isotropic basin conductivity.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Directional conductor/alteration corridor tied to a separate structural boundary, not a broad high-conductivity habitat mask.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_fault: A fault damage/alteration corridor beneath basin fill may be conductive even where no surface scarp is visible; clay-rich fill and lithologic contacts are alternatives.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H-E uses local conductivity/basement/gravity co-location; H-H uses conductivity as a bridge between paired edge endpoints. This tests along-axis versus across-axis contrast at explicit offsets.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: None for first screen; competition layers suffice.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Radiometric-ratio lineaments conditional on an independent structure edge
ranked_hypotheses.operator: After auditing units, zeros, and mask, compute robust local log-ratio features (e.g. log K/Th and U/Th) and score narrow ratio-change lineaments only where they intersect an independently detected basement/potential-field edge.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: A locally anomalous radiometric ratio boundary co-located with an independent structural edge; no absolute radiometric magnitude or generic prospectivity score.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_fault: Some hydrothermal alteration/fluid-rock interaction can modify near-surface radiometric response, but lithology, soil, moisture, cover, and flight corrections are serious confounders.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: No current model uses radiometric-ratio lineament/structural-edge interaction; existing conductive-relay features use electrical conductivity instead. Broad alteration and radiometric families have sibling prior art.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: No new acquisition: public USGS GeoDAWN release provides radiometric products; local four-band copy is a hash-pinned owner mirror and not organizer-authenticated.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Earthquake-density ridge conditioned on an independent structural edge
ranked_hypotheses.operator: Compare an earthquake-density ridge intersecting an independent potential-field/basement edge against edge-only and seismicity-only controls.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Active seismicity aligned with a separate subsurface structural edge.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missing_fault: A seismic lineament can indicate an active unmapped structure, but completeness, swarms, diffuse seismicity, and aseismic faults can reverse the signal.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: The current stack has seismicity bands as ordinary predictors, but no explicit preregistered interaction with independently detected edges.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium after source metadata review; not viable yet.
ranked_hypotheses.external_data: GDR 1391 lists public earthquake-density model data; inspect its metadata to resolve the exact band parameters before use.
